SLOTS.note: A normal sol has three job slots.

SOLAR_MAX.note: Simplified clean-sky solar power per sol.

AIR_MAKER_USE.note: Air Maker power use while running.

DUST_RATE.note: Simplified dust increase per sol, capped at 70.

CREW_AIR_USE.note: Simplified air use per astronaut per sol; tuned so Air Maker care matters.

AIR_MAKER_OUT.note: Simplified full Air Maker output; tuned so Air planning matters throughout the mission.

AIR_MAKER_WEAR.note: Air Maker health lost while running.

BLOCKS_PER_LAYER.note: Blocks needed for one shield layer.

SHIELD_STEP.note: Simplified dose reduction per shield layer.

DOSE_SCIENCE_WALK.note: Extra dose from a Science Walk.

WB_REST.note: Wellbeing gained by each Rest slot; tuned so resting helps but cannot replace resource work.

WB_TALK.note: Wellbeing gained when Talk to Earth is used.

WB_AIR_LOW.note: Wellbeing penalties for low air; tuned for a recoverable warning state.

WB_POWER_LOW.note: Wellbeing penalties for low power; tuned for a recoverable warning state.

MINIGAME_BONUS.note: Extra emergency success chance earned by completing the response drill.

SCIENCE_PER_WALK.note: Science points from a Science Walk.
